gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-martel-sans: Nulshock stretches wide in outline, its tracking generous and its line never shaded. Martel Sans is the one to read, with open curves and a high mean line, while the heading only wants to be looked at.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-matangi: Nulshock draws its letters as stretched, hollow outlines with wide tracking. Matangi sits beneath with hefty, twine-like strokes and open rounds, so the two feel like a machine panel beside a soft, friendly note.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro reads open and welcoming, with a gentle gap in the c and a high-waisted lowercase. Nulshock does the loud, technical outline work, and Maven Pro handles the steady running text underneath.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-michroma: Wide, wired and a bit futuristic. Michroma then gives each letter generous room on both sides, its tall-bodied lowercase making a sturdy counterpart to the heading's constant-width ribbon of outline.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-miriam-libre: Approachable is the first thing Miriam Libre says, with wire-light strokes and a lowercase that stands tall like cast iron capitals. Nulshock adds the stretched, technical outline above.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One reads clean and friendly, with wide spacing between letters and a sizable lowercase, no brush swell anywhere. Nulshock supplies the bold outline; this one carries the words.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-montserrat-underl: Montserrat Underline reads crisp and businesslike. Its lowercase looks oversized next to its capitals, so a slightly smaller size for the body text would suit it, while Nulshock stays stretched and outlined above.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. Nulshock's stretched, unpinched outline strokes sit above it, giving the page a technical top and a friendlier, plain sans underneath.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-mozilla-text: Nulshock's most telling trait is its stretched, spaced-out outline, drawn with no brush-style swell at all. And Mozilla Text, with tall bodies and flaring terminals, does the quieter work, leaving the heading to earn its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans has a large central band in the text line and curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths. Nata Sans would read smoothly down a full page, its technical-pen steadiness keeping the eye moving.
